title: Rebase de-gating re-parented the cam-e2e capture/exit block INSIDE `if app.noc_e2e` — PP_CAM_E2E=1 alone never captures and never exits
detail: The cam capture/exit block is nested inside `if app.noc_e2e` (counter + injection arms at main.odin:435-441/893-905 are siblings; only this arm is mis-nested). On origin/v2 the two arms are siblings under the deleted `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false)`. With PP_CAM_E2E=1 alone the outer if is false: zero screenshots, CAM_E2E_EXIT never breaks — the camera acceptance drive hangs forever producing nothing, contradicting the PR body's 'both env-gated' claim.
recommended_fix: Close `if app.noc_e2e` after its NOC_E2E_EXIT break and make the cam capture/exit block a sibling at the same depth (the origin/v2 structure, minus the `when`).

title: W2 nav-pin prose still describes the pre-merge layout (4 Downs / row 4 / count 5) after NOC moved to row 5 of 6
detail: The row-merge re-pointed the pin symbolically (`for i in 0..<rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_NOC`, so the pin still bites), but every comment and the failure message still say 4 Downs / row 4 / count 5 — settings_panel.odin now has SETTINGS_ROW_NOC=5, SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT=6. Stale prose misleads the next merge.
recommended_fix: Update the comments + failure message to 5 Downs / row 5 / count 6 (or make the prose symbolic like the code: 'SETTINGS_ROW_NOC Downs').

title: effect_zoom header comment still documents the deleted PP_DEBUG-gated scroll + release zoom fall-through
detail: The merge ungated the Noc_Scroll body and deleted the fall-through (the case-body comment below says so), but the proc header still describes the camera branch's r3 B2 compile-gate design — the two comments contradict each other three lines apart.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the effect_zoom header to the merged semantics: the scroll body is ungated in every build; the runtime overlay gate makes the Noc_Scroll branch live whenever the panel is on.
